name: Nightmare In Nassau
photo_attributions: Photo by Nichole via Google Maps
activities: haunted house attraction
season_dates: September 19 - November 1 (select nights from September 26 - November 1)
extra_notes: Ages 12 and older recommended. Not-So-Scary family-friendly nights available for younger guests. Three ticket types: General Admission, Fast Pass, and VIP Experience (VIP includes front-of-line access and souvenir item). First Responders receive discounted admission with valid ID at door. No flash photography/video or cell phones allowed inside. No outside food/drinks, backpacks, weapons, pets, flashlights, alcohol, or drugs permitted. Closed-toe shoes required. Parking available in mall garage Level Two, North Side Entrance. Group packages available (20+ minimum for corporate/community groups, 50+ for nonprofits). Emergency exit option available but no re-entry with same ticket. Contact: (347) 822-1909 or nightmareinnassau@gmail.com.
